verdict.rationale: Financial Connections documents structured access to balances, ownership details and transaction history. Refresh-complete webhooks support automated workflows, an agent use case ('agent-powered spending analysis' via Link CLI) is listed, and agent-readable docs exist (llms.txt, .md docs, official MCP server). However, the pack never shows the response JSON shape, field-level schemas or any enrichment such as categorization or merchant normalization, and the OpenAPI probe at docs paths returned 404. Missing for 10: documented response schemas or an OpenAPI spec, evidence of transaction enrichment (categories, merchant cleanup), example JSON payloads, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-consumable output.
